title: 第5章 盗墓贼与风水先生第6章 狮子吼
content_zh:
第5章盗墓贼与风水先生
后面是一个精壮的汉子，一身杂色的土布短打装扮，手上拿着一柄扁铲，肩上还背着一把短镐，一圈细绳缠在腰间，浑身上下灰扑扑的，就像是刚从墓穴里爬出来一般，不是那盗墓贼杜成金又是谁？
不过此时的钱半仙被人追的上气不接下气，脚步虚浮，脸色苍白，瘦弱的身子犹如风中残烛，看样子随时都有可能倒毙在地上。那钱半仙看到松鹤等一群人过来，犹如将要溺水的人抓到了救命稻草一般，连忙叫道：“救命啊，前辈救我。”
杜成金的情况也好不到哪去，气喘吁吁地，只是凭着肚子里的一口气，才没有被那钱半仙给甩掉。杜成金也看见了松鹤等人，脸上不由得一丝遗憾，不过大仇当前不能不报，杜成金也冲着众人道：“几位前辈，这是我与姓钱的之间的私人恩怨，这一次非要分个生死不可，希望你们不要随便插手。”
看着正在追逐的两人，青阳心中满是稀奇，今天到底是什么日子，一下子来了这么多人？不过他只是江湖后辈，这种场合还得是师父松鹤老道说话。
一个求救，一个不让掺和他们之间的事情，这让大家就有点为难，不过这里毕竟是西平观，青阳师徒不能不管不问，于是松鹤干咳了一声，说道：“两位都是江湖中人，有什么仇恨非要拼个你死我活呢？”
终于有人愿意伸出援手了，那钱半仙满脸都是委屈，道：“我也不知道啊，这家伙上来就杀招，就跟疯狗一样，若不是我的轻功比他稍好一些，早就成了他的铲下亡魂。”
听到钱半仙撇清的话，那杜成金顿时怒不可遏，喝道：“死到临头还不承认，真是气死我了，这一次我非要打死你不可。”
杜成金说完，抡起手中的扁铲就朝着前面的钱半仙砸去，那钱半仙虽然向着大家求救，却并没有完全放弃对杜成金的防备，眼见对方又要动手，他连忙调头拿起自己算命的招牌抵挡了起来。
转眼之间两人就打了起来，松鹤老道连忙劝道：“这中间是不是有什么误会？你们先别忙着打啊，谁是谁非总要说出个所以然来吧？”
“我是真不知道啊！”钱半仙叫屈道。
杜成金对钱半仙的态度恨得牙根痒痒，却一时半会儿又拿对方没有办法，只好恨道：“没见过像你这么不知廉耻的人，既然你跟我耍无赖，那我就当着大家的面，揭开你那无耻的嘴脸。”
见杜成金终于肯解释缘由了，松鹤总算是松了一口，那钱半仙不知是真不知道，还是故意掩饰，也作出一副洗耳恭听的样子。
杜成金放缓了手中的攻势，冲着钱半仙冷哼一声，道：“上个月你找到我，说是打听到一个秘闻，西平城一家破落户的祖上曾经非常富有，祖墓里陪葬了不少好东西，让我跟你联手一起做上一票，得到好处五五分成。这件事你总还记得吧？”
联手做上一票？得到好处五五分成？青阳撇了撇嘴，挖坟掘墓是极损阴德的事情，就算是江湖人士也很不齿，官府抓到了也是杀无赦的罪名，他一直只听说这杜成金是盗墓为生，没想到这钱半仙暗地里也做这个，这两人真是一丘之貉。
钱半仙似乎没想到杜成金会提起这件事，而且还是当着这么多人的面，他不由得老脸一红，道：“这件事是我找你的不假，可后来不是没干成吗？这也怪不得我啊。”
杜成金原以为面对自己的质问，钱半仙总该承认了吧？谁知道对方竟然轻描淡写的就否认了，他几乎被气疯了，红着眼道：“你……你真是睁着眼睛说瞎话，我从墓中挖出了那么多好东西，你竟敢说没干成？你是不是要把东西都赖掉？”
“我赖掉什么了？我什么也没得到啊！”钱半仙道。
见钱半仙还不肯承认，杜成金转头向着大家道：“都是江湖中人，你们给评评理。我和他一起做事，自然应该是共进退的，结果他在外面望风，发现有人来的时候连招呼都不打，卷起宝物就跑了，害得我被人堵了个正着，受尽了打骂与折磨，若不是我还有几手保命的手段，找机会逃了出来，这一次就彻底栽了。被人抓住也就算了，出来之后我去找他分我应有的那份，结果他一躲就是一个多月的时间，若不是这次正好遇上，还不知他要躲到什么时候呢。”
听了这些，青阳与松鹤等人总算是明白了事情的来龙去脉，两人一起盗墓，钱半仙卷了好处躲起来，害的杜成金自己被抓。盗墓不是什么好事，这两人完全是狗咬狗一嘴毛，不过江湖人士讲的就是一个道义，黑吃黑就有点伤人品了，这钱半仙做的确实不地道。

于是大家看向钱半仙的目光顿时就有了一丝不屑，那钱半仙一看不妙，连忙解释道：“我真的冤枉我了，我也是第一次干这种事，本就胆战心惊的，发现有人过去，吓得赶紧逃走，不光忘记了通知墓中的你，那些东西都没来得及拿。后来我怕被人找上门，在乡下一个多月没敢露面，真不是故意躲着你的。”
钱半仙话音刚落，杜成金就斩钉截铁的说道：“不可能，之前我明明把东西都交给你了，那些抓我的人也没有得到，现场也没有留下那些东西的踪迹，除了你还会有谁？”
钱半仙无奈的两手一摊，道：“这我就不知道了。”
“这下你没话说了吧？下去干活吃苦受累的是我，被堵在墓中抓到的也是我，挨打受罪的还是我，好处都被你占了，我却连根毛都没得到。没想到你钱半仙竟然是这种小人，这次你撞到我的手里，我绝不会放过你！”杜成金红着眼睛道。
到底是钱半仙贪污了两人盗出的东西，还是杜成金冤枉了钱半仙，公说公有理婆说婆有理，松鹤与皮应熊虽然认识二人，却对他们的真实为人并不了解，也判断不出谁对谁错。
松鹤老道与皮应熊很是无奈，也不知道该如何规劝才好，不过那场中那两人却已经等不及了，杜成金刚说完话，挥起手中的扁铲，就朝着钱半仙身上横扫而去。
（本章完）
content_en:
Chapter 5 Grave Robbers and Feng Shui Master
Behind him is a muscular man, dressed in a variegated homespun shorts, holding a flat shovel in his hand, and a short pickaxe on his shoulder. A thin rope is wrapped around his waist. He is covered in dust, as if he has just crawled out of a tomb. Who else is the tomb robber Du Chengjin?
But at this time, Qian Banxian was out of breath as he was being chased. His steps were sloppy, his face was pale, and his thin body was like a candle in the wind. It looked like he might fall to the ground at any time. When Qian Banxian saw Song He and a group of people coming over, he was like a drowning person grasping at straws, and he quickly shouted: "Help, senior, save me."
Du Chengjin's situation was not much better. He was panting. It was only the breath in his stomach that prevented him from being thrown away by the Qian Banxian. Du Chengjin also saw Song He and others, and couldn't help but have a trace of regret on his face, but he had to avenge himself now. Du Chengjin also said to everyone: "Seniors, this is a personal grudge between me and the man named Qian. This time, we have to decide whether to live or die. I hope you will not interfere casually."
Looking at the two people chasing him, Qingyang was filled with curiosity. What kind of day is it today that so many people came all of a sudden? However, he is just a junior in the martial arts world, and in this situation, Master Songhe has to speak.
One asked for help and the other refused to interfere with their affairs, which put everyone in a bit of a dilemma. However, this is Xipingguan after all, and Qingyang master and apprentice could not ignore it, so Song He coughed dryly and said: "Both of you are from the world, why do you have to fight to the death with hatred?"
Finally, someone was willing to lend a helping hand. Qian Banxian's face was filled with grievances and he said, "I don't know. This guy is just like a mad dog with his killer moves. If my Qinggong wasn't slightly better than his, I would have become his dead soul."
Hearing Qian Banxian's words of clarification, Du Chengjin became furious and shouted: "I'm so angry that you still don't admit it when you're about to die. I'm going to beat you to death this time."
After Du Chengjin finished speaking, he picked up the flat shovel in his hand and hit Qian Banxian in front of him. Although Qian Banxian asked everyone for help, he did not completely give up his guard against Du Chengjin. Seeing that the other party was about to attack again, he quickly turned around and picked up his fortune-telling sign to resist.
In the blink of an eye, the two of them started fighting, and Master Songhe quickly advised: "Is there any misunderstanding here? Don't be too busy fighting now. Who is who and who is who? You have to tell the truth, right?"
"I really don't know!" Qian Banxian exclaimed.
Du Chengjin hated Qian Banxian's attitude to the point of his teeth, but for a moment he had no choice but to say: "I have never seen such a shameless person like you. Since you are playing rogue with me, I will expose your shameless face in front of everyone."
Seeing that Du Chengjin was finally willing to explain the reason, Songhe finally breathed a sigh of relief. Qian Banxian didn't know whether he really didn't know or was deliberately covering it up, but he pretended to be all ears.
Du Chengjin slowed down his offensive, snorted coldly at Qian Banxian, and said: "Last month you came to me and said you had learned a secret. The ancestors of a poor family in Xiping City were once very rich, and there were many good things buried with them in their tombs. You asked me to join forces with you and get a 50-50 share of the benefits. Do you still remember this?"
Join forces to vote? Get a 50-50 benefit? Qingyang curled his lips. Digging graves was extremely unethical. Even people in the world looked down upon him. If the government caught him, he would be killed without mercy. He had only heard that Du Chengjin made a living by robbing tombs, but he didn't expect that Qian Banxian secretly did the same thing. These two people were the same.
Qian Banxian didn't seem to expect that Du Chengjin would mention this matter, and in front of so many people. He couldn't help but blush, and said: "It's true that I asked you to do this, but it's not like I didn't do it later.? It’s not my fault. "
Du Chengjin thought Qian Banxian should admit it when faced with his questioning, right? Who knew that the other party would deny it in an understatement. He was almost mad and said with red eyes: "You...you are really telling lies with your eyes open. I dug out so many good things from the tomb, how dare you say that I didn't do it? Are you going to throw away everything? "
"What did I miss? I didn't get anything! "Qian Banxian said.
Seeing that Qian Banxian still refused to admit it, Du Chengjin turned to everyone and said: "We are all people in the world, let you judge. When he and I worked together, we should naturally advance and retreat together. However, when he was outside looking out and found someone coming, he didn't even say hello, rolled up his treasure and ran away. As a result, I was blocked by others, beaten, scolded and tortured. If I hadn't had a few ways to save my life and found an opportunity to escape, I would have been completely defeated this time. It didn't matter if he was caught. After I came out, I went to him to share my share. As a result, he hid for more than a month. If I hadn't happened to meet him this time, I don't know how long he would have hid. "
After listening to this, Qingyang, Songhe and others finally understood the ins and outs of the matter. They robbed the tomb together, Qian Banxian took advantage and hid, and Du Chengjin himself was arrested. Grave robbing is not a good thing. These two people are completely dog-eat-dog. However, what people in the world are talking about is morality. It's a bit harmful to the gangster to steal the gangster. What Qian Banxian did is indeed unreasonable.
So everyone looked at Qian Banxian with a hint of disdain. Qian Banxian saw something bad and quickly explained: "I have really been wronged. This is my first time doing this kind of thing. I was already frightened. When I found someone passing by, I was so frightened that I ran away. Not only did I forget to notify you in the tomb, but I didn't have time to get those things." Later, I was afraid that someone would come to my door, so I didn't dare to show my face in the countryside for more than a month. I really didn't avoid you on purpose. "
As soon as Qian Banxian finished speaking, Du Chengjin said categorically: "Impossible, I clearly handed over all the things to you before, but those who arrested me didn't get them, and there was no trace of those things left at the scene. Who else could be there besides you? "
Qian Banxian spread his hands helplessly and said, "I don't know about that. "
"You have nothing to say now, right? I was the one who went down to work and suffered hardships, I was the one who was blocked in the tomb and caught, and I was the one who was beaten and suffered. You took all the benefits, but I didn't get even a hair. I didn’t expect you, Qian Banxian, to be such a villain. This time you hit my hand, I will never let you go! " Du Chengjin said with red eyes.
Was it Qian Banxian who embezzled the things they had stolen, or was it Du Chengjin who wronged Qian Banxian? The father-in-law was right and the mother-in-law was right. Although Song He and Pi Yingxiong knew the two of them, they didn't know their true personalities, and they couldn't tell who was right and who was wrong.
Songhe Laodao and Pi Yingxiong were helpless and didn't know how to persuade him, but the two people in that scene couldn't wait any longer. After Du Chenggang finished speaking, he waved the shovel in his hand and swept away towards Qian Banxian.
(End of chapter)
